query: Who won the Battle of Waterloo?
generated_response:
The Battle of Waterloo occurred on June 18-22, 1815, and was the final battle of the Napoleonic Wars. The British army led by General Napoleon Bonaparte defeated the French army under Generals Wellington and Jourdan, ending the war and marking the defeat of Napoleon as a military leader.

The main victorious general in this battle was General Jean-Baptiste de Valette, who commanded the French reserve. He played a crucial role in stopping the British advance on Paris and securing a decisive victory for the British army.
